title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three long years I've spent alongside Mejiro Ardan, carving out a moment to remember, have come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She truly left a trail of light during the Twinkle Series, an accomplishment that will be talked about for generations to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her story isn't over yet. No… She'll continue to run, rivals at her side.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe! I see that the two of you have improved further still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh! My timing was all wrong! But I won't be making that mistake next time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I could say the same. I missed the win this time, but when next we meet, both of you will bear witness to my victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, you're the one who's going to see me cross the finish line, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe!
choice_data_list: There's nothing like a good rival to pump you up.
There's nothing like a good rival to pump you up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That reminds me—we have a meeting scheduled right now, don't we? I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! You need to go, Ardan? Thanks for the race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This matter is not yet settled. We must race again, and soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, we can race as many times as you like… I shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me. Let's be off then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In this moment, Chiyono O, Yaeno, and I are all able to push one another forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This, too, was made possible thanks to all the other moments we've been through, Trainer. You've helped connect those two to my future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Allow me once again… to express my deepest gratitude.
choice_data_list: Well, I am your trainer, after all.
Well, I am your trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing our best to envision the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Recently, I finally learned how to look forward to things—to see beyond the present.
choice_data_list: What kind of future do you see?
What kind of future do you see?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see Chiyono O, Yaeno, and I continuing to push one another as we aim for greater heights…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And next to me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see you, as if nothing has changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …That's the future I see.
